sources.title: Assembly units
sources.summary: Use `scripts/assembly_units.py::plan_root_unit_change` to prepare a read-only plan when an assembly root insertion converts coordinates between drawing units. Supply the complete root insert records and explicit source and destination unit mappings from the caller's job. Each mapping contains a readable `label`, an integer `code`, and `millimetres_per_drawing_unit`; codes are descriptive inputs and do not determine scale.

sources.title: Axial motor
sources.summary: Executed case: Motenergy ME0907 source job (`${FERME_ROOT}/engineering/module-development/cad/work/component-led-2026-11-12/c005-build-01/source-job.json`). Original: [Motenergy outline 0JWT.301.073](https://eveurope.eu/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/ME0907.pdf). Reusable code: [axial_motor.py](../scripts/axial_motor.py). Runtime model: gpt-6.1-sol.

sources.title: Calibrated trace
sources.summary: Use `scripts/calibrated_trace.py` when reconstructing external geometry from a dimensioned raster drawing and no manufacturer 3D CAD is available. The helper receives source pixel points, a pixel origin, signed per-axis scale, point-pick/origin/scale uncertainties, and optional coordinate units. It returns source pixels, mapped coordinates, and a conservative per-axis worst-case interval. It performs no image tracing and does not choose datums, dimensions, units, or geometry.

sources.title: Component procedure
sources.summary: 1. **Index reading:** `scripts/part_index.py` accepts explicit `--index` paths. It reads a FERME-style component list or an existing dictionary with `entries`. `--id` selects an exact identity; `--query` matches all supplied case-insensitive text terms in the original record. Returned rows retain record kind, source path, source SHA-256 and original fields.

sources.title: Computational engineering
sources.summary: Read for actual equations, procedural geometry or solver preparation. This reference installs nothing and selects no model fidelity.

sources.title: Dimension limits and datums
sources.summary: Use a source callout as a dimensional limit when its label includes `Max`, `Min`, or another explicit bound. Preserve the bound in metadata and checks. A clearance-reference volume may use the bound as its limit surface, but its solid thickness or envelope is not a claim that the manufactured part equals that bound.

sources.title: Document cleanup
sources.summary: Use `scripts/ocs_document_cleanup.py` after a component model has passed its save/reopen persistence checks. The helper returns a separate cleanup result; it never changes the component's completed model status.

sources.title: Drawing feature checks
sources.summary: Use this procedure when a drawing dimension is compared with imported or reconstructed geometry.

sources.title: Envelope job runner
sources.summary: Use `scripts/envelope_job_runner.py` to run an external, source-pinned envelope job through the existing OCS `Client`, `Journal`, `envelope_reference`, `source_metadata`, and `save_reopen` APIs. Component names, source values, request namespace, output path, and scope stay in the caller's job directory. The generic runner contains no product identifiers or dimensions.

sources.title: Envelope reference
sources.summary: Use `${SKILL_ROOT}/scripts/envelope_reference.py` when the source supports an overall product or clearance envelope and a detailed component body is not available. The output is one axis-aligned reference volume. It carries no implied PCB outline, mounting surface, connector locations or physical construction.

sources.title: Existing model start check
sources.summary: 1. Run this check before every component start. It reads the external input manifest, work index, model paths, input-sheet links and files. It runs no CAD operations. Existing model paths, recorded scope and checks supply reuse evidence.

sources.title: Hexagonal reference
sources.summary: Use `scripts/hexagonal_reference.py` when an external component job supplies a regular hexagonal across-flats dimension and axial height. The helper creates one six-sided prism reference with the caller's placement frame. A caller may add a source-dimensioned coaxial through-bore by binding a required diameter feature; a nominal thread designation by itself remains axis metadata.

sources.title: Non geometric requirements
sources.summary: Use this classification only when the component input explicitly states that no CAD geometry is required. The classification is a caller-supplied job declaration; the checker does not infer it from a component name, group, prose or feature values.

sources.title: Ocs control
sources.summary: Initial live evidence: OCS 2026.42, Linux, 2026-10-20. Native control works even without MCP tools exposed in this chat. Existing session descriptors under OCS configuration (normal or Snap) contain a session ID, local port and private token. Never print tokens. Do not launch another editor/headless process or change connection settings to evade a connection failure.

sources.title: Ocs runtime
sources.summary: 1. **Software:** Python 3.12 on Linux or macOS, the pinned packages in [requirements.txt](../requirements.txt), and an already-running OpenCADStudio native-control session. The transport uses a local TCP socket and the existing session descriptor. It reads the session's authentication token privately.

sources.title: Package completion
sources.summary: This development operation runs from the 3D CAD Modeling source repository root after an authorized reusable tooling change. The source repository owns `scripts/build_skill_packages.py` and its tests. The installed skill carries its runtime code.

sources.title: Paths
sources.summary: 1. `SKILL_ROOT` is the installed cad-ocs-engineering directory containing `SKILL.md`. Resolve its bundled code from `SKILL_ROOT/scripts`; keep the package intact.

sources.title: Profile reference
sources.summary: Use `scripts/profile_reference.py` when an external project supplies a closed, straight-segment profile trace and a source-defined extrusion depth for a reference volume. This representation can preserve a manufacturer-view silhouette for packaging or clearance work. It does not infer curved edges, hidden features, wall thickness or manufacturing construction.

sources.summary: Use `scripts/retained_artifacts.py` after the final source/path/provenance edits and before the component result commit. It reads caller-owned files and prints a JSON result; it changes no artifact or manifest and connects to no CAD session.

sources.title: Small bms
sources.summary: The official Rev00 dimension drawing identifies `BMS400100300 smallBMS NG`, states millimetres, and gives the housing envelope as 107 × 46 × 23 mm. Its mounting detail gives 97 mm slot-axis pitch, 12 mm slot-end-arc centre separation, `R1.75 (4x)`, and 3 mm mounting-foot thickness. The STEP AP214 file is linked from the same official product page and contains nine placed solids inside thirteen block references. Preserve the drawing values as source claims and record the STEP member names and coordinates as separate model observations.
